eredes.guide_toggle: How to get the cURL command
eredes.guide_security: The command contains your login session. It is stored encrypted and used only to fetch your consumption.
eredes.guide_step_1: Log in to Balcão Digital in your browser.
eredes.guide_step_2: Go to 'Os meus locais' → 'Produção, consumos e potências' → 'Consultar histórico'.
eredes.guide_step_4: Choose the date range and click 'Exportar excel'.
eredes.guide_step_5: Right-click the export request → 'Copy' → 'Copy as cURL'.
eredes.guide_step_6: Paste it here and click Save.
